title: Red Rocks and Dinosaur Ridge on Ebikes
includes: Panniers (1 small bag on top and one on side, like a backpack to put items into)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Ebikes can't easily take anyone uphill if they are over 300 lbs
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us for an unforgettable guided eBike tour through some of the Denver area’s most scenic, historic, and iconic locations.

We’ll kick things off harming historic town of Morrison before making our way to the top of the legendary Red Rocks Amphitheatre, where you’ll enjoy stunning views and an up-close look at one of the world’s most famous music venues.

Next, we’ll climb to Dinosaur Ridge, where nearly 300 real dinosaur tracks and fossils offer a rare glimpse into Colorado’s prehistoric past—an experience you won’t find on an ordinary bike ride.

We will then pass by the scenic areas of Golden, passing the Jefferson County Courthouse, Fossil Trace Golf Club, and the Lakota Hills neighborhood.

This 20-mile route takes about 3 hours and is made fun, easy and accessible on an eBike—perfect for riders of all experience levels.
